title: Team Up
subtitle: Find people to build something with: a café, a studio, a service or a startup. Start by answering a few questions about how you like to work.
hint: There are no right answers. Partners who see money, time and risk the same way argue less.

question.acceptable: Answers you accept from a partner
question.acceptableHint: Pick everything that works for you
question.importance: How important is this to you?

done.title: All questions answered!
done.text: Check your matches. You can change any answer below at any time.

matching.title: Matching
matching.description: When matching is on, others who also turned it on see your name and how well you match. Your individual answers are never shown to anyone.

matches.empty: No matches yet. You need at least 3 answered questions in common with someone, so answer a few more.
matches.disabledText: Turn on matching to see who you could build something with.

errors.load: Could not load questions. Please try again later.
